info.title: Planly Learning API
info.description: Adaptive interview tutor, durable worker, and learning evaluation service

get.description:
Canonical system health endpoint.
Verified by B01-AC2.

Protected owner endpoint verifying token validity and private-owner authorization.
Verified by B02-AC2 and B02-AC3.

put.description: Updates code artifact. Rejects stale writes when expected_revision != current_revision.

get.description: Retrieves the latest or specified artifact revision for a session.

schema.title: Response Get Session Artifact Endpoint Api Sessions  Session Id  Artifact Get

get.description: Returns message history for a session to restore state on reload.

schema.title: Response Get Session Messages Endpoint Api Sessions  Session Id  Messages Get

post.description:
Submits a learner message to the durable worker queue.
- B04-AC1: Two competing tabs yield one accepted foreground run and one explicit revision/active conflict (409).
- B04-AC2: Deduplicates requests with matching client_request_id.
- Returns 202 Accepted with status and reconnectable events URLs.

get.description: Lists all classrooms for the authenticated owner.

schema.title: Response Get Classrooms Api Classrooms Get

get.description: Retrieves a specific classroom.
Lists all sessions belonging to a classroom.

schema.title: Response Get Classroom Sessions Api Classrooms  Classroom Id  Sessions Get

post.description: Creates a new session in a classroom.

get.description: Retrieves a specific session.

post.description: Records an immutable attempt / frozen submission.

get.description: Returns all attempts for a session.

schema.title: Response Get Attempts Api Sessions  Session Id  Attempts Get

post.description: Records immutable learning observation. Enforces B03-AC2 invariant.

get.description: Returns all learning observations for a session.

schema.title: Response Get Observations Api Sessions  Session Id  Observations Get

get.description:
Returns authoritative ContextPacket for teaching decisions using hybrid retrieval and explicit learning links.
Verified by B07-AC1, B07-AC2, and B07-AC3.

Returns real-time budget status across pools under the shared monthly ceiling.
Enforces OPERATING_PROFILE.md limits.
Verified by B06-AC4.
Returns all teaching decisions formulated for this session.

schema.title: Response Get Decisions Api Sessions  Session Id  Decisions Get

get.description: Returns active and completed micro-goals for the session.

schema.title: Response Get Micro Goals Api Sessions  Session Id  Micro Goals Get

put.description: Updates an editable lesson micro-goal description or status.

get.description: Returns candidate-facing activity definition, strictly stripping evaluator-only context (B08-AC3).

post.description:
Executes a complete adaptive lesson turn through the LangGraph StateGraph workflow.
Verified by B08-AC1, B08-AC2, and B08-AC3.

Executes learner Python code against test suite with strict bounds and out-of-band result extraction.
Verified by B10-AC1, B10-AC2, and B10-AC3.

get.description: Returns all execution evidence records for a session.

schema.title: Response Get Session Executions Endpoint Api Sessions  Session Id  Executions Get

get.description: Retrieves a specific execution record.

post.description:
Executes a queued turn run using the LangGraph lesson workflow.
Emits THINKING, DECISION, CHUNK, and DONE events.

get.description: Retrieves current durable status and decision for a run.

B04-AC3: Resumes event streaming after sequence number `after_seq`.
Provides reconnectable, ordered event delivery.

post.description:
B04-AC3: Cancels an active run. Preserves all previously accepted input,
persisted sequence of events, and emits a CANCELLED event.

get.description: Returns complete internal TurnRunRecord including fencing and leasing metadata.
Returns external call billing/model receipt for verification.

post.description:
Processes the next turn job for this run using the lesson worker,
generating chunk, thinking, and done events and updating run state.

Triggers idempotent ingestion of historical chat exports from downloads directory.
Verified by B05-AC1.

get.description:
Returns preserved pending tasks across tracks (Two Pointers, Prefix Sums, CS Follow-ups, ML Regression).
Verified by B05-AC3.

schema.title: Response List Pending Tasks Api Pending Tasks Get
